layers.source: Sun and Stack (2020), USGS SIM 3464, DOI 10.3133/sim3464
layers.method: Vector contacts and unit polygons reprojected to Mars 2000 lon/lat and clipped to Jezero basemap bounds.
layers.note: USGS geologic map units. Context only. Documented 100 to 200 m offset from surface-operations CTX mosaic.

layers.product: HiRISE DTM 1 m/px resampled to 5 m baseline
layers.method: 5 m slope baseline in degrees, classified into 5 bins. Transparent alpha for nodata.
layers.note: Slope from HiRISE DTM, 5 m baseline. Not a trafficability model. Coverage is limited to DTM footprints.

layers.source: HiRISE DTM 5 m slope raster query
layers.method: Median slope within 100 m of documented target coordinates. Neretva and rim targets lack DTM coverage.
